violations.explanation: Both semanticsLabel and label are optional. For the icon-only variant, if no semanticsLabel is passed, the button has no accessible name. excludeSemantics: true also suppresses any fallback from child widgets. Screen readers would announce only 'button'. The API does not enforce a name.

GestureDetector is not focusable and does not respond to keyboard activation keys such as Enter or Space. Keyboard and switch-access users cannot reach or activate the button. No visible focus indicator is provided either. InkWell or a Material button would provide these.

violations.affected_code: BoxDecoration(color: buttonColor ...), Icon(icon, size: 28, color: buttonIconColor)
violations.explanation: The foreground and background colors are passed in arbitrarily. Nothing ensures sufficient contrast between buttonIconColor and buttonColor for the text and icon.
